meta.title: Negotiation Skills Test
meta.description: A detailed 500-question reflection across 20 dimensions of negotiation skill.

levels.label: Highly Skilled Negotiator
levels.desc: You consistently prepare, understand interests, communicate clearly, create value, manage pressure, and close agreements responsibly.

levels.label: Strong Negotiator
levels.desc: Your negotiation habits are effective across most dimensions, with a few opportunities to become more deliberate or adaptable.

levels.label: Developing Negotiator
levels.desc: You demonstrate several useful skills, though preparation, value creation, assertiveness, or closing may vary by situation.

levels.label: Emerging Negotiator
levels.desc: Some foundations are present, but a clearer process for interests, alternatives, listening, and trade-offs could strengthen outcomes.

levels.label: Inconsistent Negotiation Process
levels.desc: Your approach may often become reactive, position-focused, or unclear. Start with preparation, listening, and defined limits.

levels.label: Negotiation Foundations Needed
levels.desc: Current habits may offer limited preparation, information, or structure. Practising one dimension at a time can build confidence.
